headline: The cheapest electric Škoda is here. The carmaker cuts the price of the Epiq by 120 thousand and attacks competitors
summary: Škoda Auto launches sales of the Epiq 40, its most affordable electric car, with a smaller battery and a price from 659,000 crowns. The model offers up to 328 km range and 10-80% charging in 23 minutes.
why: Škoda Auto is the Czech carmaker within the Volkswagen Group, and its pricing in the small electric vehicle segment affects competition in the mass-market EV space.
